claims: "Cream Abdul-Jabbar" is the popular nickname for Robbie Avila.
Robbie Avila is a 6'10" center for the Saint Louis University Billikens.
The nickname "Cream Abdul-Jabbar" was coined during Robbie Avila's time at Indiana State.
Robbie Avila's other nicknames include "Larry Nerd" and "College Jokic".
Robbie Avila transferred to Saint Louis University for the 2024-25 season.
Robbie Avila transferred to Saint Louis University to reunite with coach Josh Schertz.
Robbie Avila had a sophomore season at Indiana State.
Robbie Avila was a finalist for the 2025 Kareem Abdul-Jabbar Center of the Year Award.
Robbie Avila earned All-MVC honors in 2024.
Robbie Avila earned All-Atlantic 10 honors in 2025.
Robbie Avila led Saint Louis University to the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
